usage: The word '地產' (dei6 caan2) is a noun and refers to real estate or property.
You can use '地產' to talk about buying, selling, or investing in property.
'地產' is often used in business, finance, and housing contexts.
When describing an industry, you can say '地產行業' to mean the real estate industry.
'地產' can be combined with other words like '買' (buy) or '租' (rent) to specify an action related to real estate.
